# Jalali arithmetic

`jalaali.js` is the unmodified ESM build from `jalaali-js@2.0.1`, retrieved with npm pack (registry integrity verification preserved). License is retained as JALAALI-LICENSE.txt. Custom UI lives in ../jalali-picker.js, not in this vendored file. Backend uses pinned jdatetime/jalali-core. Dates remain Gregorian UTC in storage; timezone is Asia/Tehran at presentation/selection boundaries.
